verses.original: וְנֶ֗פֶשׁ כִּֽי־ תַקְרִ֞יב קָרְבַּ֤ן מִנְחָה֙ לַֽיהוָ֔ה סֹ֖לֶת יִהְיֶ֣ה קָרְבָּנ֑וֹ וְיָצַ֤ק עָלֶ֙יהָ֙ שֶׁ֔מֶן וְנָתַ֥ן עָלֶ֖יהָ לְבֹנָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ne·p̄eš kî- ṯaq·rîḇ qā·rə·ban min·ḥāh Yah·weh sō·leṯ yih·yeh qā·rə·bā·nōw wə·yā·ṣaq ‘ā·le·hā še·men wə·nā·ṯan ‘ā·le·hā lə·ḇō·nāh
verses.literal: When anyone brings a grain offering . . . to the LORD his offering must consist of fine flour . . . He is to pour olive oil on it put frankincense on it
verses.literalPt: E QUANDO alguma pessoa oferecer oferta de alimentos ao SENHOR, a sua oferta será de flor de farinha, e nela deitará azeite, e porá o incenso sobre ela;

verses.original: וֶֽהֱבִיאָ֗הּ אֶל־ בְּנֵ֣י אַהֲרֹן֮ הַכֹּהֲנִים֒ וְקָמַ֨ץ מִשָּׁ֜ם מְלֹ֣א קֻמְצ֗וֹ מִסָּלְתָּהּ֙ וּמִשַּׁמְנָ֔הּ עַ֖ל כָּל־ לְבֹנָתָ֑הּ וְהִקְטִ֨יר הַכֹּהֵ֜ן אֶת־ אַזְכָּרָתָהּ֙ הַמִּזְבֵּ֔חָה אִשֵּׁ֛ה רֵ֥יחַ נִיחֹ֖חַ לַיהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: we·hĕ·ḇî·’āh ’el- bə·nê ’a·hă·rōn hak·kō·hă·nîm wə·qā·maṣ miš·šām mə·lō qum·ṣōw mis·sā·lə·tāh ū·miš·šam·nāh ‘al kāl- lə·ḇō·nā·ṯāh wə·hiq·ṭîr hak·kō·hên ’eṯ- ’az·kā·rā·ṯāh ham·miz·bê·ḥāh ’iš·šêh rê·aḥ nî·ḥō·aḥ Yah·weh
verses.literal: and bring it to Aaron’s sons the priests The priest shall take a handful . . . . . . . . . of the flour and oil together with all the frankincense and burn this as a memorial portion on the altar a food offering a pleasing aroma to the LORD
verses.literalPt: E a trará aos filhos de Arão, os sacerdotes, um dos quais tomará dela um punhado da flor de farinha, e do seu azeite com todo o seu incenso; e o sacerdote a queimará como memorial sobre o altar; oferta queimada é, de cheiro suave ao SENHOR.

verses.original: וְהַנּוֹתֶ֙רֶת֙ מִן־ הַמִּנְחָ֔ה לְאַהֲרֹ֖ן וּלְבָנָ֑יו קֹ֥דֶשׁ קָֽדָשִׁ֖ים מֵאִשֵּׁ֥י יְהוָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·han·nō·w·ṯe·reṯ min- ham·min·ḥāh lə·’a·hă·rōn ū·lə·ḇā·nāw qō·ḏeš qā·ḏā·šîm mê·’iš·šê Yah·weh
verses.literal: The remainder of the grain offering shall belong to Aaron and his sons it is a most holy part of the food offerings to the LORD
verses.literalPt: E o que sobejar da oferta de alimentos, será de Arão e de seus filhos; coisa santíssima é, das ofertas queimadas ao SENHOR.

verses.original: וְכִ֥י תַקְרִ֛ב קָרְבַּ֥ן מִנְחָ֖ה מַאֲפֵ֣ה תַנּ֑וּר סֹ֣לֶת חַלּ֤וֹת מַצֹּת֙ בְּלוּלֹ֣ת בַּשֶּׁ֔מֶן וּרְקִיקֵ֥י מַצּ֖וֹת מְשֻׁחִ֥ים בַּשָּֽׁמֶן׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵî ṯaq·riḇ qā·rə·ban min·ḥāh ma·’ă·p̄êh ṯan·nūr sō·leṯ ḥal·lō·wṯ maṣ·ṣōṯ bə·lū·lōṯ baš·še·men ū·rə·qî·qê maṣ·ṣō·wṯ mə·šu·ḥîm baš·šā·men
verses.literal: Now if you bring an offering of grain . . . baked in an oven it must consist of fine flour either unleavened cakes mixed with oil or unleavened wafers coated with oil
verses.literalPt: E, quando ofereceres oferta de alimentos, cozida no forno, será de bolos ázimos de flor de farinha, amassados com azeite, e coscorões ázimos untados com azeite.

verses.original: וְאִם־ מִנְחָ֥ה עַל־ הַֽמַּחֲבַ֖ת קָרְבָּנֶ֑ךָ סֹ֛לֶת בְּלוּלָ֥ה בַשֶּׁ֖מֶן מַצָּ֥ה תִהְיֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’im- min·ḥāh ‘al- ham·ma·ḥă·ḇaṯ qā·rə·bā·ne·ḵā sō·leṯ bə·lū·lāh ḇaš·še·men maṣ·ṣāh ṯih·yeh
verses.literal: If your offering is a grain offering prepared on a griddle it must be unleavened bread made of fine flour mixed with oil
verses.literalPt: E, se a tua oferta for oferta de alimentos cozida na caçoula, será da flor de farinha sem fermento, amassada com azeite.

verses.original: פָּת֤וֹת אֹתָהּ֙ פִּתִּ֔ים וְיָצַקְתָּ֥ עָלֶ֖יהָ שָׁ֑מֶן מִנְחָ֖ה הִֽוא׃ס
verses.transliteration: pā·ṯō·wṯ ’ō·ṯāh pit·tîm wə·yā·ṣaq·tā ‘ā·le·hā šā·men min·ḥāh hî
verses.literal: Crumble it - and pour oil on it it is a grain offering
verses.literalPt: Em pedaços a partirás, e sobre ela deitarás azeite; oferta é de alimentos.

verses.original: וְאִם־ מִנְחַ֥ת מַרְחֶ֖שֶׁת קָרְבָּנֶ֑ךָ סֹ֥לֶת בַּשֶּׁ֖מֶן תֵּעָשֶֽׂה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’im- min·ḥaṯ mar·ḥe·šeṯ qā·rə·bā·ne·ḵā sō·leṯ baš·še·men tê·‘ā·śeh
verses.literal: If your offering is a grain offering cooked in a pan it must consist of fine flour with oil
verses.literalPt: E, se a tua oferta for oferta de alimentos de frigideira, far-se-á da flor de farinha com azeite.

verses.original: וְהֵבֵאתָ֣ אֶת־ הַמִּנְחָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֧ר יֵעָשֶׂ֛ה מֵאֵ֖לֶּה לַיהוָ֑ה וְהִקְרִיבָהּ֙ אֶל־ הַכֹּהֵ֔ן וְהִגִּישָׁ֖הּ אֶל־ הַמִּזְבֵּֽחַ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hê·ḇê·ṯā ’eṯ- ham·min·ḥāh ’ă·šer yê·‘ā·śeh mê·’êl·leh Yah·weh wə·hiq·rî·ḇāh ’el- hak·kō·hên wə·hig·gî·šāh ’el- ham·miz·bê·aḥ
verses.literal: When you bring to the LORD the grain offering made in any of these ways it is to be presented to the priest and he shall take it to the altar
verses.literalPt: Então trarás a oferta de alimentos, que se fará daquilo, ao SENHOR; e se apresentará ao sacerdote, o qual a levará ao altar.

verses.original: וְהֵרִ֨ים הַכֹּהֵ֤ן מִן־ הַמִּנְחָה֙ אֶת־ אַזְכָּ֣רָתָ֔הּ וְהִקְטִ֖יר הַמִּזְבֵּ֑חָה אִשֵּׁ֛ה רֵ֥יחַ נִיחֹ֖חַ לַיהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hê·rîm hak·kō·hên min- ham·min·ḥāh ’eṯ- ’az·kā·rā·ṯāh wə·hiq·ṭîr ham·miz·bê·ḥāh ’iš·šêh rê·aḥ nî·ḥō·aḥ Yah·weh
verses.literal: The priest is to remove the memorial portion from the grain offering and burn it on the altar as a food offering a pleasing aroma to the LORD
verses.literalPt: E o sacerdote tomará daquela oferta de alimentos como memorial, e a queimará sobre o altar; oferta queimada é de cheiro suave ao SENHOR.

verses.original: וְהַנּוֹתֶ֙רֶת֙ מִן־ הַמִּנְחָ֔ה לְאַהֲרֹ֖ן וּלְבָנָ֑יו קֹ֥דֶשׁ קָֽדָשִׁ֖ים מֵאִשֵּׁ֥י יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·han·nō·w·ṯe·reṯ min- ham·min·ḥāh lə·’a·hă·rōn ū·lə·ḇā·nāw qō·ḏeš qā·ḏā·šîm mê·’iš·šê Yah·weh
verses.literal: But the remainder of the grain offering shall belong to Aaron and his sons it is a most holy part of the food offerings to the LORD
verses.literalPt: E, o que sobejar da oferta de alimentos, será de Arão e de seus filhos; coisa santíssima é, das ofertas queimadas ao SENHOR.

verses.original: כָּל־ הַמִּנְחָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֤ר תַּקְרִ֙יבוּ֙ לַיהוָ֔ה לֹ֥א תֵעָשֶׂ֖ה חָמֵ֑ץ כִּ֤י כָל־ שְׂאֹר֙ וְכָל־ דְּבַ֔שׁ לֹֽא־ תַקְטִ֧ירוּ מִמֶּ֛נּוּ אִשֶּׁ֖ה לַֽיהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: kāl- ham·min·ḥāh ’ă·šer taq·rî·ḇū Yah·weh lō ṯê·‘ā·śeh ḥā·mêṣ kî ḵāl śə·’ōr wə·ḵāl də·ḇaš lō- ṯaq·ṭî·rū mim·men·nū ’iš·šeh Yah·weh
verses.literal: No . . . grain offering that you present to the LORD may be made with leaven for you are not to burn . . . any leaven . . . or honey as a food offering to the LORD
verses.literalPt: Nenhuma oferta de alimentos, que oferecerdes ao SENHOR, se fará com fermento; porque de nenhum fermento, nem de mel algum, oferecereis oferta queimada ao SENHOR.

verses.original: קָרְבַּ֥ן רֵאשִׁ֛ית תַּקְרִ֥יבוּ אֹתָ֖ם לַיהוָ֑ה וְאֶל־ הַמִּזְבֵּ֥חַ לֹא־ יַעֲל֖וּ לְרֵ֥יחַ נִיחֹֽחַ׃
verses.transliteration: qā·rə·ban rê·šîṯ taq·rî·ḇū ’ō·ṯām Yah·weh wə·’el- ham·miz·bê·aḥ lō- ya·‘ă·lū lə·rê·aḥ nî·ḥō·aḥ
verses.literal: You may bring them to the LORD as an offering of firstfruits but they must not go up on the altar as a pleasing aroma
verses.literalPt: Deles oferecereis ao SENHOR por oferta das primícias; porém sobre o altar não subirão por cheiro suave.

verses.original: וְכָל־ קָרְבַּ֣ן מִנְחָתְךָ֮ בַּמֶּ֣לַח תִּמְלָח֒ וְלֹ֣א תַשְׁבִּ֗ית מֶ֚לַח בְּרִ֣ית אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ מֵעַ֖ל מִנְחָתֶ֑ךָ עַ֥ל כָּל־ קָרְבָּנְךָ֖ תַּקְרִ֥יב מֶֽלַח׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵāl qā·rə·ban min·ḥā·ṯə·ḵā bam·me·laḥ tim·lāḥ wə·lō ṯaš·bîṯ me·laḥ bə·rîṯ ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā mê·‘al min·ḥā·ṯe·ḵā ‘al kāl- qā·rə·bā·nə·ḵā taq·rîḇ me·laḥ
verses.literal: And you shall season each of your grain offerings . . . with salt You must not leave the salt of the covenant of your God out of your grain offering you are to add salt to each of your offerings
verses.literalPt: E todas as tuas ofertas dos teus alimentos temperarás com sal; e não deixarás faltar à tua oferta de alimentos o sal da aliança do teu Deus; em todas as tuas ofertas oferecerás sal.

verses.original: וְאִם־ תַּקְרִ֛יב מִנְחַ֥ת בִּכּוּרִ֖ים לַיהוָ֑ה אָבִ֞יב קָל֤וּי בָּאֵשׁ֙ גֶּ֣רֶשׂ כַּרְמֶ֔ל תַּקְרִ֕יב אֵ֖ת מִנְחַ֥ת בִּכּוּרֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’im- taq·rîḇ min·ḥaṯ bik·kū·rîm Yah·weh ’ā·ḇîḇ qā·lui bā·’êš ge·reś kar·mel taq·rîḇ ’êṯ min·ḥaṯ bik·kū·re·ḵā
verses.literal: If you bring a grain offering of firstfruits to the LORD you shall offer crushed heads of new grain . . . roasted on the fire
verses.literalPt: E, se fizeres ao SENHOR oferta de alimentos das primícias, oferecerás como oferta de alimentos das tuas primícias de espigas verdes, tostadas ao fogo; isto é, do grão trilhado de espigas verdes cheias.

verses.original: וְנָתַתָּ֤ עָלֶ֙יהָ֙ שֶׁ֔מֶן וְשַׂמְתָּ֥ עָלֶ֖יהָ לְבֹנָ֑ה מִנְחָ֖ה הִֽוא׃
verses.transliteration: wə·nā·ṯa·tā ‘ā·le·hā še·men wə·śam·tā ‘ā·le·hā lə·ḇō·nāh min·ḥāh hî
verses.literal: And you are to put oil . . . . . . and frankincense on it it is a grain offering
verses.literalPt: E sobre ela deitarás azeite, e porás sobre ela incenso; oferta é de alimentos.

verses.original: וְהִקְטִ֨יר הַכֹּהֵ֜ן אֶת־ אַזְכָּרָתָ֗הּ מִגִּרְשָׂהּ֙ וּמִשַּׁמְנָ֔הּ עַ֖ל כָּל־ לְבֹנָתָ֑הּ אִשֶּׁ֖ה לַיהוָֽה׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·hiq·ṭîr hak·kō·hên ’eṯ- ’az·kā·rā·ṯāh mig·gir·śāh ū·miš·šam·nāh ‘al kāl- lə·ḇō·nā·ṯāh ’iš·šeh Yah·weh
verses.literal: The priest shall then burn the memorial portion of the crushed grain and the oil together with all its frankincense as a food offering to the LORD
verses.literalPt: Assim o sacerdote queimará o seu memorial do seu grão trilhado, e do seu azeite, com todo o seu incenso; oferta queimada é ao SENHOR.
